info.title: Personalized view
info.description: Some subjects are split into several courses, for example by level or as electives. With the personalized view, the schedule and tasks only show what belongs to your own courses.

sections.title: Your courses
sections.text: You choose your courses when you join a group. You can change your selection at any time in the group settings under “My courses”.

sections.title: Showing all courses
sections.text: To see the lessons and tasks of every course again, set “Displayed Courses” to “All” in your account menu. Hiding this notice keeps the filter active.
